capture.scope: Live receipt; preview is not precision acceptance
capture.timestamp_policy: Host frameset arrival; native per-stream timestamps/skews retained; not hardware synchronization

result.timestamp_policy: ROS stamps use WSL receipt + native per-stream offsets; Windows receipt and device times retained at source. No cross-device hardware synchronization or measured transport latency.

video.content: Actual independent RViz view of live ROS topics; no synthetic poses

result.pose_matching_policy: One output per input; RGB-D color or depth stamp, stereo/lidar stamp; tolerance 1 microsecond. Coverage includes lost poses; lost separately reported.
result.metric_note: Excursion is static deviation only for an operator-declared fixed session. No ATE/RPE; no precision pass inferred from finite poses.

raw_playback.scope: Raw sensor callback playback, SQLite image counts and live frame-number coverage; no SLAM evaluation
raw_playback.coverage_note: Recording may include startup frames omitted by live frameset synchronization; every live frame must still exist in raw playback.

live.visual_review: Viewed full encoded frame at video 8s: RGB/depth/actual point cloud/TRACKING visible; view/lighting differ from old fixed recording, no fixed-camera accuracy claim
